Title: Azure AD conditional access support for limited access with Microsoft Cloud App Security is now available

Body.Content: Azure AD conditional access is now able to provide you with in-session controls to enable limited access within SaaS apps. This feature leverages Microsoft Cloud App Security's conditional access app control feature. These controls can be applied to any SAML application configured with Single Sign-on in your organization. To learn more, read our full blog post and get started today!
